scope: Documentary data integrity, qualified claims, concise factual summaries and shared geographical focuses. Source counts exclude bibliographic metadata and original explanatory interface copy. Physical accuracy and browser behavior are verified separately.

checks.label: Sixteen stable stops and ordered route
Every fact and chronology item resolves to documentary evidence
All five regions partition the route and thematic layers remain explicit
Coordinates resolve to the same focus as the exported model plan
Plaza and street focus coordinates match the contextual scene
Evidence qualifiers prevent false certainty about paintings and the synagogue
Presbytery painting and restored dome key are separate spatial and dated claims
Cutaway and collections identify the limits of the virtual visit
Concise fact and timeline summaries remain below 200 words per source
